prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1299; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, restricted cervical range of motion, and muscle spasm. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with a cervical strain. Over the course of fourteen visits, care progressed along a typical conservative pathway that included manual therapy, guided home exercise, and anti-inflammatory medication. Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced in step with recovery. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical region is known to this provider. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
